resolution: The live run showed diagnostic self-noise was still polluting the owner trace: after arming gv_churntrace, the only named owners were PlayRoute console prompt/footer churn, and those stale commits were then repeated across later unrelated spikes. I filtered that specific diagnostic console prompt/footer churn out of the reconciler owner ring and added a freshness gate so recon owner records older than 1.2s are not attached to later spike reports. This keeps terminal spike reports intact but stops stale console arming/closing from being blamed. I also added per-pipeline GPU hashes (rect_hash, text_hash, curves_hash, capsules_hash, polys_hash) to host telemetry and the JS counter set so no-React REPAINT/hash-flip spikes can identify which 2D draw buffer changed.
